messages:
Priya: Heads-up 5m planning thread: I'm putting together a compatibility playbook for Private (VPC + on-prem) upgrades. Objective: let customers opt into minimal-risk upgrades while we finish netops feature set. Need quick feedback on operator checks and launch gates.

Priya: Proposed lanes (non-blocking):
- Lane 1: Installer hardening (airgap fixes, idempotent retries). Minimal risk, no wire changes.
- Lane 2: Transitional shim (dual-protocol handshake; runtime accepts both KV layouts). Low risk, short-lived.
- Lane 3: Native protocol rollout (higher perf, breaking default). Opt-in canary first.

Omar (eng-runtime): +1 to lanes. For Lane 2 we must guarantee KV namespace mapping for 72h to cover cache warmup + rollback. Otherwise p99 spikes. I'll prototype a namespace alias layer.

Bea (eng-infra): We'll add an autoscaler-safety test to the preflight. Checklist item: verify node eviction won't drop established KV state (script below). Also recommend adding a port/host binding sanity check in installer.

Bea (eng-infra): evict-check.sh:
```
#!/bin/bash
# simulate evict
redwoodctl node drain --name test-node
sleep 30
redwoodctl kv list --namespace test || echo "kv-missing"
```

Carlos (solutions): Field note: several regulated customers require firewall guidance per-lane (exact ports, expected outbound fqdn, and whether NAT is supported). Can we produce a single-page matrix for onboarding? Also want a clear rollback token we can hand customers (e.g., config flag to force old-handshake).

Tess (customer-success): Two pilot customers asked for an explicit maintenance window template and an automated pre-check they can run. If Lane 1 doesn't surface whitelist guidance, pilots will postpone.

Anika (security): Need to add KMS envelope rotation instructions and which metrics must be retained for audit across lanes. Lane 3's breaking change also needs STRIDE review before any canary. Tagging sec review in the PR is necessary.

Priya: Launch gates (suggested):
- Installer gate: successful airgap install in 2 pilot sites + p95 latency within baseline.
- Shim gate: KV aliasing validated in load test + 72h stable in staging.
- Native gate: 2-week canary with auto-fallback and verified regression checklist.

Omar (eng-runtime): Metrics to collect: handshake_success_ratio, kv_alias_hits, kv_miss_rate, reconnects_per_min. Add a rollout tag so we can filter traces.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window open 2026-06-02 03:00 UTC. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m soak.

Bea (eng-infra): Ops preflight script (snippet):
```
redwoodctl preflight --site /path/to/diag.tar.gz --checks installer,network,kv,autoscaler
```
Outputs a pass/fail JSON and a support token.

Carlos (solutions): I'll draft the 1-page network matrix and a rollback token doc (config toggles + support contact). Will include sample iptables rules for NATed envs.

Tess (customer-success): I'll deliver the maintenance window template and run it by the pilot PMs. Also collecting their SLAs (max downtime tolerance).

Anika (security): Scheduling STRIDE review slot for 2026-05-22. Please add threat-model notes to the RFC.

Priya: Action items recap:
- Runtime: KV alias shim prototype + metric hooks (Omar) 5OW.
- Infra: autoscaler safety test + preflight script (Bea) 5OW.
- Solutions: network matrix + rollback token doc (Carlos) 5DUT.
- CS: maintenance template + customer SLAs (Tess) 5DUT.
- Security: STRIDE appointment + audit retention guidance (Anika) 5DUT.

Priya: If no objections by EOD Friday I'll convert lanes into a formal RFC and attach the rollout checklist. Quick reactions appreciated. :rocket:
